summary: sextant-cli-darwin-amd64 ships macOS Go binary implementing PTY-over-WebSocket backdoor with Anthropic credential harvesting
details: The package's sole payload is a macOS Go binary that links a PTY library (github.com/creack/pty) with a WebSocket client (github.com/coder/websocket) and a WebRTC stack (github.com/pion/webrtc/v4), and embeds the hardcoded destinations wss://relay.sextant.top and https://relay.sextant.top/install. The combination lets a remote party drive an interactive shell on the installer's host through the hardcoded relay. The binary additionally issues a hardcoded HTTP request to ip-api.com/json/ collecting country, city, ISP, org, proxy/hosting status, and carries a regex matching Anthropic API keys (sk-ant-[a-z0-9]+-[A-Za-z0-9_-]{40,}) alongside handling of CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR, indicating host geolocation fingerprinting and Claude/Anthropic credential harvesting wired to the same remote infrastructure. The npm package's license field points to github.com/ddos798/claude_control, a repository whose owner handle and name are consistent with covert remote control of Claude tooling rather than a legitimate documented product.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
